notes.title: Valentine's Day update 💖
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Valentine's Day[/b] fellow cosmic horror lovers! 

As a sign of our devotion to [b]the one who haunts our dreams[/b], we have just released an [b]update for Dagon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/4e1c1fd3bdd841c1ed2e05bff9b417916193e184.jpg[/img]

This update contains:
[list]
[*] 2 new languages: [b]Ukrainian [/b]and [b]Arabic[/b]
[*] reduced [b]build size[/b]
[*] improved translations
[*] new Turkish font
[*] fixed problems with some of the [b]Achievements[/b]
[*] fixed problems with the gamepad usage
[*] dozens of small [b]fixes and improvements[/b] in scenes and UI
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361560


The Great Old One is [b]all alone [/b]in the sunken R'lyeh... Let's show him that we think about him as much as [i]he thinks about us[/i] on this special day!

notes.title: Dagon in numbers (one year after the release)
notes.notes:
Fellow cultists!

It's been a year since our first experimental game - Dagon: by H. P. Lovecraft - emerged from the depths of R'lyeh.

Our lord, The Great Cthulhu worked hard with all his tentacles on dozens of abacuses, to come up with those blasphemous, cyclopean numbers.

On behalf of the Ancient Ones, we wanted to thank you all for your support!

I'a! Dagon!
